<!-- Generated by cargo run -p vtabs-core --bin gen-schema -- --write markdown docs/options.md -->

| Name                              | Default       | Value                                                                                                    |
| --------------------------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `keybinds`                        | `{}`          | Plugin action shortcuts. Shortcuts supplied by this plugin                                               |
| `width`                           | `256`         | Integer 32–1024. Width in logical pixels                                                                 |
| `side`                            | `"left"`      | `left`, `right`. Sidebar edge                                                                            |
| `rail`                            | `"expanded"`  | `expanded`, `hidden`. Sidebar visibility                                                                 |
| `quick_terminal_width`            | `0.75`        | Number above 0, at most 1. Fraction of the window width                                                  |
| `quick_terminal_height`           | `0.75`        | Number above 0, at most 1. Fraction of the window height                                                 |
| `quick_terminal_blur`             | `0`           | Integer 0–64. Backdrop blur radius in logical pixels behind a translucent background                     |
| `quick_terminal_opacity`          | `1.0`         | Number 0–1. Background opacity; 1 is opaque and text stays opaque                                        |
| `quick_terminal_border_color`     | `null`        | Hex color `#RRGGBB` or null. Null follows the terminal foreground at 22% opacity                         |
| `quick_terminal_background_color` | `null`        | Hex color `#RRGGBB` or null. Null follows the quick terminal palette background                          |
| `quick_terminal_auto_hide`        | `false`       | Boolean. Hide the quick terminal when the window loses focus                                             |
| `quick_terminal_preserve_shell`   | `true`        | Boolean. Keep the shell when hidden; disable to start a fresh shell each time                            |
| `quick_terminal_hide_on_escape`   | `"auto"`      | `never`, `always`, `auto`. Auto hides only while nothing runs in the shell                               |
| `animations`                      | `true`        | Boolean. Enable finite visual transitions                                                                |
| `reduced_motion`                  | `false`       | Boolean. Suppress transitions                                                                            |
| `animation_ms`                    | `140`         | Integer 0–1000. Transition duration in milliseconds                                                      |
| `cards`                           | `true`        | Boolean. Use cards instead of compact rows                                                               |
| `show_indexes`                    | `true`        | Boolean. Visible tab indices                                                                             |
| `show_metadata`                   | `false`       | Boolean. Show the session domain                                                                         |
| `show_close`                      | `true`        | Boolean. Show close controls                                                                             |
| `tab_glyphs`                      | `true`        | Boolean. Show machine glyphs on tabs                                                                     |
| `glyph_size`                      | `0.8`         | Number 0.5–1. Sidebar glyph size relative to the text                                                    |
| `tab_title`                       | `"directory"` | `directory`, `process`, `pane_title`, `process_and_directory`. Title source; renaming a tab overrides it |
| `confirm_close`                   | `true`        | Boolean. Confirm closing a tab with a running process                                                    |
| `accent`                          | `"#a9c7f5"`   | Hex color `#RRGGBB`. Default accent color                                                                |
| `background`                      | `"#192231"`   | Hex color `#RRGGBB`. Surface background                                                                  |
| `foreground`                      | `"#e1e7f0"`   | Hex color `#RRGGBB`. Text foreground                                                                     |
| `muted`                           | `"#98a8be"`   | Hex color `#RRGGBB`. Secondary text foreground                                                           |
| `selected_background`             | `"#34485f"`   | Hex color `#RRGGBB`. Selected card background                                                            |
| `hover_background`                | `null`        | Hex color `#RRGGBB` or null. Hovered card background; null follows Background                            |
| `tab_foreground`                  | `null`        | Hex color `#RRGGBB` or null. Tab title text; null follows Foreground                                     |
| `selected_foreground`             | `null`        | Hex color `#RRGGBB` or null. Selected and hovered card text; null follows Accent                         |
| `local_glyph_color`               | `null`        | Hex color `#RRGGBB` or null. Local machine glyph; null follows the tab text                              |
| `distro_colors`                   | Per OS ID     | Object of hex colors. Remote glyph colors by os-release ID, `remote` when unknown                        |
| `keyboard_shortcuts`              | `true`        | Boolean. Enable tab, search, settings and sidebar shortcuts                                              |
| `default_domain`                  | `null`        | String or null. Spawn domain used in an empty space; null retains the host default                       |
| `menus`                           | `[]`          | List. Nested semantic action menus                                                                       |
